fact: Revenue Services Lesotho's guide says taxpayers can complete and submit CIT, IIT, RIIT, T&E, VAT and PAYE returns online through its e-Taxation platform (e-Filing).

Revenue Services Lesotho's guide says tax payments can be made through its e-Payments platform using mobile money (EcoCash and M-Pesa) and by bank EFT, with Standard Lesotho Bank payments via the Unayo app reflected immediately in the RSL system.
Revenue Services Lesotho says taxpayers register on its eTax platform, log in with a username and password and file their returns there.
Revenue Services Lesotho says taxes can be paid through its e-Payments platform by mobile money and by bank electronic transfer.

LAA's Director General says the Automatic Compliance Project is already in use, with RSL retrieving PAYE files as early as August 2024, and that taxpayers can file returns from home on pre-populated PAYE forms.
Revenue Service Lesotho said its e-Taxation system was fully implemented after a pilot in the previous filing season, so clients can register and file online.
Revenue Service Lesotho said the e-Taxation system streamlines tax filing and payments for all registered clients on a unified platform, and its clinics teach e-payment.
Newsday reports that the Revenue Services Lesotho e-Tax platform now enables electronic payments, online registration and near-instant Tax Clearance Certificates.
